description: FROZEN v1.0 (fix plan Item 25, stream S6). The machine-readable twin of REPORT.md, written by stage_gate.py cmd_report beside it as <run_dir>/REPORT.json. Every field mirrors something REPORT.md prints (same values, structured), plus the fields Item 25 adds so consumers never parse Markdown: run_id, review_mode as data, warnings as a list, artifacts as a hash map. See run-events-schema.md section 5 for the field-by-field mapping to the REPORT.md text, including the mapping of the gate's current RUN COMPLETE / RUN INCOMPLETE line and Review mode line onto these fields.

artifacts.description: Every close-recorded artifact hash across all stages merged into one map (run-folder-relative path to SHA-256 hex), the union of the per-stage artifact_hashes.

compare_sheets.description: The REPORT.md Compare sheets list (paths of responsive-html/compare/*.png), empty when the stage has not closed.

generated_at.description: When cmd_report ran (REPORT.md's 'Generated by scripts/stage_gate.py report at' line).

hygiene.description: Browser-session hygiene line. RESERVED PLACEHOLDER for S7's Item 33 (browser teardown and hygiene gate): until Item 33 lands, reports carry status 'not_recorded' and null counts, exactly as shown. Item 33 fills the counts from private/browser-sessions.jsonl and the browser-hygiene receipt; the stage cannot close with unaccounted above 0.

overall.description: 'complete' when every required stage closed PASS or NOT AUTHORIZED (REPORT.md's RUN COMPLETE), 'incomplete' otherwise (RUN INCOMPLETE), 'test-run' when intake.test_run is true, regardless of completeness (Item 25's vocabulary).

owner_blocked.description: Named owner-blocked waits affecting this run (for example: failed-run identification, gold images for calibration, layout reference files), one string each, named plainly. Reserved: a gate with no owner-block source yet emits an empty list rather than omitting the field.

review_mode.description: Item 7's stamp as data. 'line' is the exact string the gate prints under the overall line in REPORT.md (compute_review_mode), kept so the JSON twin and the Markdown can never disagree about wording.

author_sessions.description: Distinct author sessions across the run's v2 review files.

overlap_stages.description: Stages where a reviewer session overlapped an author session (the SELF-REVIEWED case); empty otherwise.

reviewer_sessions.description: Distinct reviewer sessions across the run's v2 review files.

run_id.description: The run's UUID from private/state.json (Item 24). Null only for a report generated by a gate build that predates Item 24's run_id; consumers must tolerate null and key such reports by path.

stages.description: One entry per stage, in stage-contract.json stage_order, exactly the rows of REPORT.md's Stages table plus the evidence behind each row.

closed_at.description: state.json closed_at; null when the stage never closed.

cost.description: Present when the stage receipt carries cost; credits_used = credits_before - credits_after.

duration_s.description: Receipt finished_at minus started_at in seconds (REPORT.md's Duration column); null when either timestamp is missing.

receipt_status.description: The stage receipt's own status field; null when no receipt exists.

review_files.description: Run-folder-relative paths of the stage's Review Receipt v2 files, as recorded at close.

status.description: The REPORT.md stage line, verbatim vocabulary (the gate's stage_line): PASS, NOT AUTHORIZED, FAIL, BLOCKED, or NOT RUN.

totals.description: REPORT.md's Cost and Slowest stages sections as data.

cost_by_provider.description: Provider to total credits used, summed from receipts (credits_before - credits_after). Empty object when no image-stage receipt carried cost fields: REPORT.md prints its explicit no-cost-data line in that case, never an assumed zero with a number's confidence; the empty object is that same honesty in data form.

slowest_stages.description: Up to three slowest closed stages, slowest first.

waivers.description: Downgrades and waivers in force for this run (for example an intake-recorded layout-references waiver), one named string each, mirroring what Item 6 requires REPORT.md to print. Reserved like owner_blocked: empty list when none are in force, never omitted.

warnings.description: REPORT.md's WARN list, verbatim, one string per WARN (without the '- WARN:' prefix). Includes the uncalibrated-grade notice and the test-run notice when they apply.

title: Skill 71 REPORT.json (twin of REPORT.md)
